validity.recommendation: Do not fill refs / do not treat as green. Verify this specific 10-inch line exists as a distinct asset (Aramco facilities list / OGJ worldwide pipeline survey) before retaining; otherwise merge with P1922.
validity.researcher_notes: The sheet's ONLY citation for P1923 is 'OPEC Annual Statistics Bulletin 2012, p.75'. I fetched that PDF through url_verifier: it returns 200 but does NOT contain the tokens 'Abu Ali' or 'pipeline' — it is a country statistics bulletin (reserves/production tables), not a pipeline register, so it does not name this line and provides zero support for its existence, name, length, diameter, or status. No independent source I could find names a distinct 'Berri-Abu Ali 2' 10-inch gas pipeline. Independent sources (Saipem 'Berri Downstream Pipeline'; NS Energy 'Berri Oil Field Expansion'; OGN; gcscontracting) DO confirm the real geographic corridor and facilities — the Abu Ali Island gas/oil separation plant (~50 km N of Ras Tanura) connected to the Berri Gas Plant / Khursaniyah Gas Plant near Jubail, all Aramco — but those describe the 2019-2024 Berri Increment pipelines (a newer, larger project), not a pre-2012 10-inch line. So: the corridor and endpoints are real, the operator (Aramco) is real, but the specific entity 'Berri-Abu Ali 2' with its 39 km / 10-inch / operating specs is supported only by a non-naming statistical bulletin i.e. it is effectively GEM-internal. Specs are unverifiable against any independent source. Existence of this as a separate row is doubtful.

validity.recommendation: Human de-dup review vs P1922. Confirm whether P1922 (8 in) and P1923 (10 in) are a genuine twin/parallel pair or a double-count of one line; merge if the latter. Also reconcile against P1921/P7768 (Abu Ali-Berri, 30 in, 22 km).
validity.researcher_notes: P1923 is near-identical to P1922 'Berri-Abu Ali Gas Pipeline': SAME endpoints (Eastern Province -> Abu Ali Island / Berri Gas Plant), SAME length (both 39.00 km), differing ONLY in diameter (P1922 = 8 in, P1923 = 10 in). The '2' suffix is GEM's parallel-line naming pattern (cf. P1898/P1899 UBTG-1-Berri & UBTG-1-Berri 2; P1917/P1918/P1919 Haradh Khuff-Hawiyah 1/2/3), so P1923 MAY be a legitimate twin line — but both rows trace to the same non-naming OPEC-ASB citation, so neither is independently corroborated as a separate asset, and a single physical line entered twice with two nominal diameters cannot be ruled out. There is ALSO a reverse-named cluster in the roster: P1921 'Abu Ali-Berri Gas Pipeline' (30 in, 44 km) and P7768 'Abu Ali-Berri / Sub-sea' (30 in, 22 km) run the same corridor in the opposite naming direction. GulfPub (Dec-2025 SDE, 20 SA gas features) has NO Berri-Abu Ali record at all — its nearest is 'Qatif - Berri Pipeline' (29 in, 32 km), a different line — so GulfPub neither corroborates P1923 nor helps distinguish it from P1922. Net: strong relabel/double-count suspicion within the Berri/Abu Ali family; the P1922<->P1923 pair is the tightest match.

validity.recommendation: Reassess as a gathering/feeder line rather than a transmission trunk; confirm it carries sales/associated gas (not crude/condensate) between the Abu Ali GOSP and Berri Gas Plant.
validity.researcher_notes: A 10-inch (and its twin's 8-inch), ~39 km line between the Abu Ali oil/gas separation plant and the Berri Gas Plant is gathering/feeder scale, not a gas transmission trunk (compare the real trunks in-scope: East-West 48 in / 1200 km, MGS lines 56 in). Fuel is listed 'Gas' with FuelSource 'Berri Gas Plant'; the Abu Ali facility is primarily a crude GOSP, so this small line most plausibly moves associated/feed gas within the Berri complex rather than being a standalone transmission pipeline. Flagging as a classification caveat, secondary to the existence/duplicate concerns.

routes.corridor_desc: Corridor runs along the Eastern Province Gulf coast from the Berri Gas Plant near Jubail northward to Abu Ali Island (a coastal island linked to the mainland by causeway, ~50 km N of Ras Tanura, hosting Aramco's Abu Ali GOSP). Great-circle distance between the two facilities is ~30 km, consistent with a routed length near the sheet's 39 km. Endpoints are independently confirmed as real Aramco facilities (NS Energy, Saipem); the exact routed alignment is NOT independently traced, so this is a loose corridor, not a surveyed route. Coordinates are approximate, defensible from the named facilities, and flagged as such — not surveyed.
routes.researcher_notes: Endpoints established from independent descriptions of the Abu Ali Island GOSP and the Berri Gas Plant near Jubail and their connecting pipeline corridor (NS Energy, Saipem, both verified 200 + tokens present). Coordinates are approximate values derived from the named, real facilities (Abu Ali Island ~27.32N 49.55E; Berri Gas Plant near Jubail ~27.05N 49.60E), NOT surveyed and NOT fabricated to false precision; no independent route geometry exists to tighten the alignment, hence suggested accuracy stays low.

summary: P1923 concern (existence + duplicate + classification): only cited source (OPEC ASB 2012 p.75) does not name the line and no independent source confirms a distinct 10-in Berri-Abu Ali 2; near-identical to P1922 (same endpoints/39 km, differs only 8 vs 10 in) and small-diameter (gathering, not trunk); route corridor Berri Gas Plant<->Abu Ali Island suggested at low accuracy.
